method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, formula and token comparison, and reverse paraphrase after a bounded fresh check of official Maharashtra antecedent/consequent terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: The opening sequent-calculus section: section title, sequence metavariables, sequent and initial-sequent definitions, truth-condition explanation including both empty-side cases, sequence appending and concatenation, derivation trees, and the logical/structural rule distinction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section is titled Rules and Derivations; the protected plural derivation token is retained.
samples.checks: Rules is translated, while the token name, plurality switch and section macro are unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For the section, Gamma, Delta, Pi and Lambda denote finite sequences of sentences.
samples.checks: All four Greek metavariables, their order, the sentence token and finiteness are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A sequent is an expression Gamma sequent-arrow Delta, where both sides are possibly empty finite sequences of sentences of L. Gamma is the antecedent and Delta the succedent.
samples.checks: The displayed form, language macro, both possible-emptiness and finiteness restrictions, and the two side assignments are preserved; पूर्वांग/उत्तरांग are explicitly defined here rather than treated as a conditional's parts.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A sequent holds exactly when, if every antecedent sentence holds, at least one succedent sentence holds. For listed A_i and B_j this is the displayed conjunction-to-disjunction conditional. With an empty antecedent it reduces to the succedent disjunction; with an empty succedent it reduces to the negation of the antecedent conjunction. The sequent is valid exactly when that corresponding sentence is valid.
samples.checks: The universal/existential force, biconditionals, m=0 and n=0 cases, formulas, polarity, and distinction between truth in the explanation and formal validity in the final clause are all retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma comma A appends A at Gamma's right end; A comma Gamma appends it at the left. Gamma comma Delta concatenates the two sentence sequences.
samples.checks: Right and left directions, notation, sequence typing and concatenation order are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For any sentence A, an initial sequent has A sequent-arrow A; when the relevant tags are enabled, empty-left true and false empty-right are the other two permitted forms.
samples.checks: The prvFalse/prvTrue tag condition, enumerate structure, both tagitem guards, empty arguments, three formulas and untagged fallback remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Sequent-calculus derivations are trees of sequents whose top sequents are initial; every sequent below one or two others must follow correctly from them by an inference rule. LK rules divide into logical and structural rules. A logical rule is named for the main operator of the A/B-containing sentence in its lower sequent, and has left and right versions according to the side on which that operator-containing sentence occurs.
samples.checks: Tree orientation, one-or-two parent arity, inference dependence, LK, both rule classes, lower-sequent qualification, main-operator naming and left/right versions are preserved.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
क्रमवर्ती कलन is directly attested, but the standalone sequent noun क्रमवर्ती remains a definition-controlled nominalization.

पूर्वांग is directly attested for antecedent and उत्तरांग for consequent; no checked official source directly attests succedent, so its sequent-right-side use and आरंभीची क्रमवर्ती remain provisional.
तार्किक नियम and संरचनात्मक नियम are transparent, source-defined compounds; the exact pair was not found in the checked Marathi authorities.
